content:
Sanjay: Heads up — planning to promote RC rc-embed-v3.2.0-20240305 to prod in ~60m. Cross-region plan: us-east1 -> europe-west1 -> asia-south1 with a 10m traffic cooldown per region.

Ellie: +1 on timing, PM verified release notes and migration notes. Are we pinning the artifact and KV schema version?

Sanjay: Yes. Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:sha-abcdef1234. KV schema v2. Migration is additive, backfill runs in background. I pinned model weights to v3-quant.

Tom: Logging and trace keys ready. Small note: europe-west1 has had higher p95 last 24h — recommend slower ramp there (5% -> 20% -> 100% with 5m holds).

Violet: Product asks for a 30m quiet window after full promotion for smoke e2e. Can we accommodate?

Sanjay: We can. Plan updated: us-east1 (fast ramp 0->50->100 with 2m cooldown), europe-west1 (5->20->60->100 with 5m cooldown), asia-south1 (10->50->100 with 10m cooldown). Quiet window 30m after final region.

Ellie: Sounds good. Rollback trigger conditions: error rate >1.5% sustained for 3 min OR embedding failure ratio >0.5% for 5min. Also manual rollback allowed by oncall.

Ops-oncall: noted. Add deadman hook to abort promotion if KV migration lag spikes > 10k/sec.

Sanjay: Added. Rollback command snippet saved in runbook:

```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n embeddings set image deploy/embeddings-service embeddings=gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:sha-ff112233
# clear new schema flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://internal-admin/redwood/feature-flags/emb_schema_v2/disable
```

Tom: Can we get a quick smoke checklist here so sheriffs can follow?

Ellie: I uploaded the release notes and the smoke checklist to the runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/rc-embed-v3.2.0. Key checks: sanity embeddings on 10 sample prompts, latency p95 per region, end-to-end raft health, backfill lag.

Sanjay: Good. Requesting explicit +1 from @ellie and @tom to trigger promotion.

Ellie: +1 :thumbsup:

Tom: +1 (watching europe-west1) :eyes:

Sanjay: Locking the artifact and pinning deploy window. Initiating promote in 10m unless anyone objects.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued by sanjay for rc-embed-v3.2.0-20240305. Estimated window 00:25. Pipeline: build verification -> canary -> region ramps.

deploy-bot: Canary passed (3/3 health checks). Starting us-east1 ramp now: 0 -> 50% traffic.

Ellie: quick smoke: embeddings check pass on canary UUID 3f2a. Latency looks good.

deploy-bot: us-east1 at 50% -> escalating to 100% in 2m cooldown.

ops-oncall: monitoring p95 and error trends. All green so far.

deploy-bot: us-east1 at 100%. Moving to europe-west1 with staged ramp.

deploy-bot: europe-west1 5% -> 20% (5m hold).

Tom: europe-west1 p95 jumped 0.8% but still within threshold. continuing.

deploy-bot: europe-west1 60% -> 100% (final hold before which we enable quiet window).

Violet: enabling quiet window now (30m) for PM review. Please don't do any infra pushes during quiet window unless critical.

deploy-bot: asia-south1 ramp starting: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m cooldown per step.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete, rc-embed-v3.2.0 promoted to prod. Quiet window active for 30m.

Ellie: Release notes live. PM signoff received. Great job team.

Sanjay: If anything degrades, use rollback snippet above and ping ops-oncall. After quiet window I'll open the post-promo checklist and schedule the small backfill job throttle.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll run the post-promo telemetry sweep at quiet window end and post results here.

Violet: Thanks — updating release tracker and closing the RC. :party-popper:

Sanjay: Closing thread in ~40m once quiet window ends and post-promo checks are green.
